messages.snippet: Sarah, James, Charles and Gregory have shaken hands on the commercials: EV £24.5m, equity £22.4m aft
messages.subject: Project Drake — heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Charles and Gregory have shaken hands on the commercials: EV £24.5m, equity £22.4m after £2.1m net debt, £19.9m cash at completion, £1.5m escrow for 18 months, and up to £1m earn-out on FY2026 EBITDA. Eight-week exclusivity. Can you put these into heads of terms?

Nathan

messages.subject: RE: Project Drake — heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

Draft heads of terms attached reflecting those terms, marked subject to contract save for exclusivity, costs, confidentiality and governing law (which are binding). I've set the earn-out sliding scale at £3.2m–£3.8m FY2026 EBITDA. Once you're happy we'll send to Birchall Stone.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
